in_hebrew.name: Frulla
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Maiden, young woman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Frulla הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'frumentum', meaning 'grain' or 'corn'. In Roman mythology, Frumentum was the goddess of grain. Frulla could be a feminine variation of this goddess name.

in_greek.name: Frulla
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Maiden, young woman
in_greek.long_meaning: Frulla είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'frumentum', meaning 'grain' or 'corn'. In Roman mythology, Frumentum was the goddess of grain. Frulla could be a feminine variation of this goddess name.

in_latin.name: Frulla
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Maiden, young woman
in_latin.long_meaning: Frulla est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Latin word 'frumentum', meaning 'grain' or 'corn'. In Roman mythology, Frumentum was the goddess of grain. Frulla could be a feminine variation of this goddess name.
